name: zfmv_action_derived_scalar_deleting_destructor
description: zFMV_Action::DerivedScalarDeletingDestructor runs the base action destructor, optionally deletes self for flags bit 0, and returns self.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zFMV action/source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x462e70 validates the scalar deleting destructor shape: call zFMV_ActionBase::Destructor, test flags bit 0, optionally call operator delete(self), return self, and clean the flags argument.
The dependency frontier has no source blockers: zFMV_ActionBase::Destructor is functional-equivalent and operator delete is a CRT provider boundary.
The existing native smoke verifies DerivedScalarDeletingDestructor(0) returns self and restores the base action vtable without deleting.
